verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows PayPal's Payouts API (paypal-docs-5, paypal-docs-24, paypal-docs-41) which is for mass-disbursing money to third-party recipients, not for controlling a merchant's own payout schedule or reconciling a payout's constituent charges/fees/refunds. There is no documentation of payout scheduling settings, itemized payout reports, or reconciliation exports; the closest item (list_transaction/get_merchant_insights agent tools) is generic transaction reporting, not payout-level breakdown. missing for 10: payout schedule configuration, itemized payout reconciliation report showing charges/fees/refunds per payout, any documented reconciliation/settlement API.
